6. Privacy
Registration information is used to provide and maintain your account and app features. Do not enter information that is not requested. Our collection and handling of personal information must also follow the privacy notice and applicable data-protection laws.

7. Changes to these Terms
We may revise these Terms as the service changes. We will make the updated Terms available in the app and indicate when they take effect. If your consent is required for a material change, we will request it before you continue using the affected service.
